verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a dashboard of income, expenses and VAT liability, a trial balance, a BWA report and invoice-to-payment matching. None of it mentions an accounts payable aging report, per-vendor balances, or as-of-date reporting. A general trial balance and dashboard are adjacent features, not AP aging or vendor balances, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
